text_block_list.text: The day of the Flora Stakes—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Was it today's Flora Stakes?
The one where that Umamusume from the famous "Splendid Clan" is running.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Right on!
Man, I can't wait to see how she runs in graded stakes races!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(Today's race is a touchstone...
A true test of my ability at medium distance.)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(...I must stay vigilant. This race is
directly connected to the Oaks, after all—)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...Thank you for having me today.
Let us make it a great race."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Your performance in the previous Oka Sho was magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
An always steady, orderly race execution.
And the sharpness to never miss the decisive moment—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
At present, I recognize you
as the greatest threat on this Tiara route.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: In today's race, I intend to defeat you and all the others, carving my path toward the glory of the Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Unfortunately, I also intend to carve out my own path in this race.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
So, I don't intend to give it up so easily.
...In fact, I plan on having you give it to me.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Well then—
Let us settle the rest on the racetrack.
